scope: Calibration only, not independent qualification; all original roster, truth and prediction rows verified.

calibration.confidence_definition: Reported probability of the actual emitted label
calibration.scope: Descriptive pair-weighted calibration; ECE alone is not a release gate

bootstrap.limitations: Percentile bootstrap is descriptive; few cohorts or unrepresentative models cannot establish generalization.

scores.scope: Scoring only; caller must establish prospective freezing, independence, biological coverage and acceptance criteria.

published_metric.formula: sum_k N_k * TP_k / (TP_k + FN_k + FP_k) / sum_k N_k
published_metric.scope: Independent implementation of the published formula; not organizer-executable parity or scientific release authorization
